{{Quote|Ventress found me. We fought. I lost. She took my lightsaber. I composed myself for the killing blow, but instead she took me prisoner. She blindfolded me and bundled me into a speeder for a short ride, no more than an hour. Count Dooku was waiting at the end of it.|Jai Maruk|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], there was a '''duel on Vjun''' between [[Jedi Master]] [[Jai Maruk]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], which the latter won. Ventress took Maruk as prisoner and delivered him to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We were running recon in the Outer Rim. Began to think there was something funny going on in the neighborhood of the Hydian Way. Little drab transports kept popping up, like a mermyn-trail leading into and out of the Wayland region.|Jai Maruk|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Jai Maruk]] was on patrol in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] when a curious pattern of small transports kept appearing in the area, which caught his notice. Aboard his [[starfighter]] ''[[Limit of Vision]]'', a [[Seltaya-class fast courier|''Seltaya''-class fast courier]], he tailed one of the transports to its rendezvous on the [[planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], and made a soft landing many [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from it. Despite keeping his heat and IR signatures low, he was still discovered by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-aligned [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==The duel==
{{Quote|Make no mistake, I am here because Dooku wanted me here. Ventress would have killed me if she could, she made that very plain, but Dooku wanted a messenger.|Jai Maruk|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous" />}}
They engaged in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Duel (short story)|duel]], and Maruk made the mistake of underestimating Ventress. For the first few passes in their fight, he tried disarming her; by the time he realized his folly it was already too late, she had taken the initiative and drove him back with her relentless attacks. His balance and defensive posture was slowly eroded by his increasing wild parries and Ventress was able to disarm him of his lightsaber. She blindfolded her prisoner and brought Maruk to [[Château Malreaux]], where the Separatist leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was residing as his base of operations. Ventress wanted to kill Maruk to increase her tally of slain Jedi to seventeen, but Dooku released him in order to deliver a message to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|That's it, seventeen.|Asajj Ventress taunting Jai Maruk to give in to his hate|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous" />}}
Back in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Maruk replayed the duel in his mind, analyzing everything and cataloging every mistake he made. He imagined their rematch a hundred times, choosing which attacks would be most successful and which opening stances to use. What Maruk failed to admit in his self analysis was that she was simply better than he was. When they crossed paths again on [[Phindar Station]] during a secret [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|mission]] to Vjun, he finally realized this and came close to falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] due to his frustration and hatred. It was only the intervention of his colleague Master [[Maks Leem]] that Maruk was able to stay within the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]. When Ventress finally cut him down with a fatal slash to the abdomen, Maruk was at peace and smiling.
